name: haqms-workspace
description: Hospital Appointment and Queue Management System (HAQMS) - Candidate Assessment Workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma
